tldr: Pluto in the 3rd house: power becomes personal through communication, learning, siblings, neighbors, and daily movement.
body:
With Pluto in the 3rd house, this part of you intensifies communication, learning, siblings, neighbors, and daily movement. Pluto describes power, pressure, truth, control, fear, attachment, and deep change. In practice, this brings attention to the conversations, questions, messages, errands, and local patterns that shape how you make sense of life.

When this placement is supported, your words and observations can become more useful and easier to trust. Pluto can become depth, honesty, resilience, and the ability to face what has been buried.

When it is strained, your attention can scatter, or the same thought can loop without becoming a clear choice. The harder pattern can show up as control, obsession, compulsion, or trying to force an outcome that needs to change.
gift: depth, honesty, resilience, and the ability to face what has been buried expressed through communication, learning, siblings, neighbors, and daily movement.
challenge: control, obsession, compulsion, or trying to force an outcome that needs to change around communication, learning, siblings, neighbors, and daily movement.
